item.tib: bstan srung a bse rgyal ba'i gsol mchod kyi 'phrin las
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni bstan srung a bse rgyal ba'i sgrub thabs dang / las kyi mtha' phun sum tshogs par mang ba'i/ 'di 'dra byed pa mi dgos thang te phyogs 'dir 'di 'dra'i dpe cha ma 'dzoms pa'i/ skong mdos 'bul dus yid ches kyi tshogs ma bachis te/ dmu rigs drang srong shes rab dbang ldan gyis bskul ngor/ skyang sprul nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis shing bya lor dbyar ra ba'i yar tshes la yi dam gyad phur gyi bsgrub pa'i skabs su sngon gyi bskang (skong) ba rnams la dpe blangs nas brtsams bgyis pa la/ ma rig dbang gi 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa lha dang srung ma'i thugs la bzod par gsol//
